text: ……めずらしい　ポケモン　つかまえたら　みせに　きたって！

structure.jp: ……めずらしい　ポケモン　つかまえたら
structure.en: if you catch a rare Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing has happened. つかまえたら = 'if you catch one'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before 'come' or 'go' tells what you come to do. みせに　きたって = 'come to show me'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: きたって is the Kansai dialect way of saying きてやって, a friendly 'do it for me' request. きたって = 'do come by'.
